entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.6
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **Servers work on the TF2 update of 30 October 2026.** Windows servers load SigMod again, so the community missions that need it start at their first wave instead of staying on wave 0. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * chore(deps): pin everything keyed to TF2 11191711 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/253 * feat(ci): open the pins pull request when TF2 moves by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/254 * chore(release): v1.18.6 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/255 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.5...v1.18.6 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZWFhZTA5YjZmYmQyZmY2OTBlNjMyODkwZmMxZmMwNGQ6MTc5MzUzNzY0Nw==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZjkwNzZiNmFhMzRkY2FhYmJhMTQ2MDBkYTk2ODVkZWI6MTc5MzUzNzY1MA==/detection)

entry.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong v0.5.4
entry.content:
Changelog may be shorter but quality > quantity (plus it means there are fewer problems to solve yay) What a backbreaking week, hope this resolves most things standing out and adds a bunch of fun stuff, been working on this whenever time allowed me to and the mappers have done insane work. (Also usual small offer to [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) if you feel like supporting this)
# Changelog
## Major
- Improved Swim randomization: water falls now return Hornet to her last safe dry landing when possible - Items from supported multiworld games now display their own icons in shops, quest previews and sent-item notifications - Added shared and per-crest Bind randomization for healing and interactions that require Bind - New randomization options: Cogheart Pieces, Crawbell, Farsight, Bellhome Items, Materium (plus Flintstone, Volstone and Magnetite) - Rosary economy for ER/Enemy Souls/Ledge Grab rando
## Minor
- **Massive logic updates in pretty much everywhere** - Corrected departure logic at nine paid Bellways, including Grand Bellway, so their own randomized station item is no longer required - Fixed Bellway menus allowing travel to locked Bone Bottom on alternative start locations. Empty destination menus now close safely instead of crashing - Fixed Wish Shuffle courier offers overlooking completed Queen’s Egg and Liquid Lacquer - Fixed Liquid Lacquer’s offer appearing in logic before its required second completion - Fixed logic incorrectly using an uncollected vanilla ability to reach its own pickup - Fixed Bell Beast remaining invisible after purchasing a station - Fixed Fourth Chorus becoming inaccessible after leaving during the cloak quest with F4 - Fixed falling into Groal’s muckwater without Swim returning you outside the arena - Fixed missing randomized Silkeaters ItemIcon - Fixed shorter goals retaining unavailable relic turn-ins and later-area locations - Fixed silk barricade logic incorrectly allowing Hunter, Reaper, Beast and Shaman crests without Needle Strike - Fixed some generation failures involving vanilla Bellways and Craftmetal - Fixed Act 1 availability checks when later abilities are randomized - Added grave-marker and Ruined Chapel Rosary stashes to Rosary Cache randomization (they don't have the lil AP rosary icon yet) - Impossible solo configurations now stop sooner with a clearer error - Fixed darkness and camera positioning at Terminus' upper entrances in Act 3 - Fixed freezing when turning around on a Clawline ring with only one direction unlocked - Sherma's duplicate-not-duplicate can now record the Songclave meeting correctly (relevant for wish-shuffle Balm for the Wounded) - Fixed the Bone Bottom intro incorrectly marking Moss Mother defeated - Fixed Seth's camera swinging left when entering from the right - Fixed Caretaker mistakenly looking for Lace 2 kill instead of boss-credit with boss-sanity on - Fixed some missing UT map images and misplaced item coordinates
### Beta Features
- Fixed collection wishes appearing in logic without the enemy souls needed to obtain their materials - Fixed entering Slab Chilly Prison from above leaving the room hidden - Fixed missing First Kill routes, including Choir Bellbearer and Reed - Removed the incorrect soul requirement for breaking Vog’s floor

entry.title: Outer Wilds v1.4.1
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).
- Interstellar Warp Drive item and related behavior changes to warp unlocks and Launch Codes (from @RS-Mind) - As the name implies, the new IWD item is required to use the ship's "Interstellar Mode" to warp to or from any custom system added by story mods. - The Launch Codes item has been reimplemented. Now you can sit down in the pilot's seat without it, and instead most of the controls won't work without it. This tweak allows you to warp to other systems without Launch Codes, so the Interstellar Warp Drive and Launch Codes items are both individually valuable. - Forgotten Castaways: The "Deep Bramble Coordinates" item has been removed. IWD is a replacement and generalization of it. - FC Logsanity: As part of that generalization, IWD does not block you from checking "DB Ship Log: Stranded Nomai 5 - Warp" and "FC Ship Log: Bramble's Doorstep 2 - Nomai" the way DBC did. - Hearth's Neighbor (1): The warp to the custom system is no longer unlocked by looking at the new museum object, but simply by receiving IWD. - Fret's Quest: Normally, the custom system warp is unlocked by "FQ: The Ritual (Text Wheel)" just before entering the custom system. This often felt like a bug when randomizing FQ, because entering the custom system without reading that text wheel is perfectly reasonable behavior when you don't have the Translator. The randomizer now "fixes" this by making "FQ: Ask About New Planet" unlock the custom system warp instead. - Last but not least: The randomizer now disables the "You have a warp drive!" text that pops up when you first enter your ship. - Astral Vision item and related changes to Astral Codec (from @aXu-AP) - The vision takes effect immediately upon receiving the item; no visit to the Tesseract necessary. That means some checks on LC and ET can become in logic without Launch Codes. - The Tesseract is missing until you get the item. Checks from interacting with the Tesseract are triggered when the player approaches the Tesseract with Astral Vision. - The Stranger Light Modulator is now required to push a raft, so it won't be as easy to circumnavigate the Stranger out of logic. - The "Randomize Ghost Matter" mod setting is now on by default. Combined with the Astral Vision rework, this should make ghost matter logic more meaningful than it used to be. - The "Randomize Stranger Codes" mod setting is now on by default. - Added upgrade_maxima option to go along with upgrade_counts. - This changes the semantics of upgrade_counts. Previously each upgrade added 50% to a stat no matter how many there were, so increasing upgrade_counts would also increase the maximum %s. Now the randomizer will calculate the %-per-upgrade based on both options, so increasing only upgrade_counts will now make each individual upgrade weaker. - The idea is to eventually remove the mod's overly flexible logic-breaking settings for oxygen/fuel/boost (which were originally only intended as a testing tool), once we're confident that these more carefully designed options cover most of the unproblematic customization players want to do. - Updated required_friends' maximum to 10 now that Heliostudy exists. - Corrected Heliostudy "Friend" description from "You have already was" to "You have already been". - Internal logic refactors and tests. I'm mostly mentioning this in case it causes weird bugs. The only player-facing impacts should be: - The logic now uses Rule Builder, so Universal Tracker's `/explain` command will have better output (not that you need UT when we have the in-game tracker). - Putting a vanilla warp connection in warp_platform_plando now works instead of crashing generation

entry.title: Northgard v2026.11.2
entry.content:
> **This is an Alpha.** Bifrost mode is brand new and still needs a lot more testing, so expect some bugs. If something looks off, let me know on the Discord. Conquest works the same as before.
### Added - **Bifrost mode!** Set `game_mode: bifrost` in your YAML to play the roguelite instead of Conquest. Your progress carries over between runs, won or lost, so you'll be doing plenty of runs. - Realms are now items. A realm you don't have yet shows greyed out in the lobby and can't be picked, and it lights up as soon as you get it. Midgard is always open, and completing Vanaheim is the goal. - Objectives are checks: portals, the Wyvern, the Nidavellir Beacon, the Pillar of God and the Befriend objectives. - Some cards on perk screens are checks too. They show the Archipelago logo, hovering one tells you what item it holds, and they get hinted for everyone when the screen opens. The `ap_perk_cards` option sets how many there are. - New bonus items: Military, Economy, Special, Clan and Objective Bonus, one bonus per realm, and Building Unlock. Each one gives you a random perk or building that fits your clan, every run, and shows up in the game's Bonuses tab. - Co-op works too: everyone joins the same slot and runs their own client, and every player gets their own bonuses. - `/bifrost` in the client shows which realms you have and how many checks are left in each.
### Changed - Checks and items now go through in about a second instead of up to 5, in both modes. - Conquest-only options are now labeled "(Conquest)" so it's clear which mode they're for. - The client updates the Northgard patch by itself when you connect, like before.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.10.25...2026.11.02

entry.title: DOOM Eternal v0.7.3
entry.content:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.7.3
Bug fixes for Linux/Proton disconnections, item and DeathLink delivery, stuck encounters, and the broken camera after dying without a usable weapon.
Use **Mod and APWorld 0.7.3** with **Sentinel Core 1.1.4**.
## Launcher and connection
- Fixed Linux/Proton disconnections ("keepalive ping timeout") while the game was running. Checking whether DOOM is running no longer blocks the connection to the Archipelago server. - Fixed automatic reconnection failing with an error after the client switched from `ws://` to `wss://`. - When the game connection helper stops under Linux/Proton, the launcher now says so and suggests checking the selected Proton version, instead of asking to close a game that is not running.
## Item delivery and DeathLink
- Fixed items and DeathLinks not arriving in game on some machines until a relaunch. The Core rejected valid game reads that took slightly longer than its time limit; that limit is now more tolerant. - DeathLinks that the Core refuses before running them are now retried instead of being lost.
## Encounters and enemy randomization
- `ap_finish_encounter` can now also end an encounter stuck waiting for enemies that never spawned, where it previously answered "No active encounter". - Tentacles are no longer in the default enemy pool for new rooms; they can still be enabled through Bestiary Weights. In existing rooms, Tentacles are replaced by a mobile enemy when the launcher prepares the room package again, since a Tentacle in an unreachable spot could keep an encounter from ending (for example, the **Super Gore Nest** Slayer Gate and the arena after the BFG in **Mars Core**). - Fixed floating hands, a broken camera and the player appearing tiny after dying or loading a checkpoint with no ammo and a randomized Chainsaw. The player's owned weapon is now selected even when it has no ammo.
## Campaign menu
- The Slayer Gate icon in the mission menu now shows a Gate as completed only when you completed it in game in this save. A Gate collected by another player stays open, so you still know to complete it for its Empyrean Key. Gates completed before this version show as open until completed again.
## Support Reports and diagnostics
- Added diagnostics for Ammo Refill, showing what each ammo pool had before and after a refill. - Added diagnostics for encounters whose enemies fail to spawn and for `ap_finish_encounter` refusals. - Added diagnostics for goal evaluation, recording why victory was or was not sent. - Spawn position diagnostics now cover every map instead of only the first one.
**These fixes do not require a new room. Rooms that work with v0.7.2 keep working. The Tentacle default applies to rooms generated with APWorld v0.7.3; the Tentacle replacement in existing rooms applies when the launcher prepares the room package again.**

entry.title: Dead Cells v0.2.0
entry.content:
New Features: - Added an option for enemy sanity checks, meaning killing one enemy of each kind counts as a check - Added a room randomizer (will randomly switch biome places) with 3 options: - depth: close to the classic experience by only swapping biomes in the same depth - tier: swaps the biomes by groups delimited by bosses - chaotic: can replace any biome with any other biome - Note that the Bank still works in the same way as usual - This gamemode is still a work in progress, so it is not advised to use it in multiplayer, the in-game tracker isn’t adapted yet, and some other features may not work correctly. - Gave back a use to the hunter's mirror. - A random accessible enemy will be selected upon interaction with the mirror - Killing the enemy will randomly hint at one of your accessible checks and slightly reduce the price of the mod shop
Gameplay Changes: - Now shop mimic blueprints also have a hunter's grenade requirement - The distillery doesn’t require you to have seen the throne room beforehand - Increased the number of lore rooms in Prisoners’ Quarters to a maximum of 4 new and 2 previously generated and not looted - Disclaimer: adding more rooms increases the complexity of the level and increases the time needed for generation, so it is advised to loot them as soon as possible - Changed fixed weapon drops, now giving a random filler-like item instead - A trap weight can be selected for the filler generation, and is also used in death traps
Quality of Life: - Refactored the UI control logic to improve stability and allow the use of mouse and controller at the same time without crashing - Writing in a text field locks the cursor in it, avoiding unwanted movements in the menu - Disabled launching the game when connected to an incompatible apworld - Improved responsiveness for text fields and item descriptions
Bug Fixes: - Some item descriptions not being displayed - Mutation checks not being counted for the green hole head - Lag when putting a lot of cells in the forge at once - Warp being based on biome checks - Some crashes caused by a disconnection - Cells being deposited in energy link upon death - Removed the warp option when doing daily challenge, boss rush and training - Hunter grenade icon still showing on mobs without blueprints when picking up the grenade before a blueprint - Bank losing its depth mobs upon reload - Gray text display on biome, showing checks as accessible when they are from non-accessible higher BSC - Scrolls on mobs given again on reload - Flower keys that could be picked multiple times using reload
APWorld Changes: - Complete rework of the apworld, fixing many fill issues - Added the enemy sanity, room randomizer and trap weight options - White hole head now requires one Progressive Flask, Cursed Flask, Tainted Flask, or access to the Bank - Golden Blowtorch is now a Bank item - Spoiler and universal tracker not taking into account that all stem cells are required for the goal
Other: - Changed the image reading library, as SixLabors now requires a license
Compatible with APWorld 0.1.7 and newer

Hover over locked checks to see what they require - In-client hints: Click just about anything in the client to request a hint for it - New Goal: Parrot Hunt! Receive clues from the multiworld to discover which stateroom the parrot is trapped in - New YAML options (see YAML for detailed descriptions): - Passenger Class Upgrades: Multiworld (default) or Vanilla - Stateroom Assignments: Multiworld (default) or Vanilla - AP Item Delivery Method: Succ-u-Bus (default) or Direct to Inventory - More Room Access Card generation options: Enabled, Randomized, Selection, Disabled (default) - Easy Music Room Puzzle: (default false) When true, pre-sets the music room panel controls to the solution - Skip Intro: Skips past the intro and opening credits - Quick Elevator/Quick Pellerator: Drastically shortens ride animations - Quick Barbot Freakout: Drastically shortens animation and control lockout after completing the Titanic Titillator - New Checks: Puree the Starlings, Defeat the Maitre'D, Music Room puzzle, SGT Stateroom Furniture puzzle, Arboretum Seasons - Added YAML-less UT Support ## Changes - Traps have been removed temporarily. entry.title: Manual_TheVault_Chakraa v2026.11.3
entry.content:
### ADDED - **Extra Keys** option (`extra_keys_percent`, 0 to 100%, default 20%): hides more key value in the multiworld than you need, so you don't have to find every single key. The helper items like "Bringing in the Explosives! (+10 Vault Keys)" count towards it. - **Vault Stages** option (`vault_stages`, 1 to 10, default 1): opens The Vault bit by bit. With 4 stages, every 25% of your keys opens a quarter of the Treasures. 1 keeps the old behavior, everything opens at once. - **Keys Outside The Vault** option (`keys_outside_vault`, on by default): your keys are never hidden in your own Treasures, so the other worlds always hold them.
### CHANGED - "Keys to open The Vault" is now exactly the amount of keys you need. Before, The Vault always needed 100 keys and you started with the ones you weren't asked to find. - Generation now stops with a clear message when The Vault is the only game in the multiworld, since its keys have to be hidden in other games. - If the other games don't have enough room for all your keys, the extra keys are lowered first, then you start with some keys already in hand. The generation log tells you when this happens.

# Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks Archipelago 1.2.0
## What's new * `Wu-Shi Start` is now `Portal Start`: New Game starts you in the Portal, the bridge to Wu-Shi is locked behind the new `Wu-Shi access` item * All 8 ko-op only Red Koins are collectible in single player (60 → 68), ko-op doors only need one button * Added `Smoke Missions` option, a check for each of Smoke's 5 missions, progress is autosaved * Added `Lock Special Moves` option, the first special move upgrade for each move unlocks it (VS characters too) * Added the `Final boss health pickup` item, beating Kano no longer unlocks it * Mana regenerates faster with each mana upgrade, a full bar refills in about the same time * The brutality room Red Koin is spawned by breaking the statues again, but you don't need to beat Reptile to start them * The client detects saves that don't belong to your slot and leaves the game alone until you return to the main menu * Red Koins checked from outside the game (`!collect`, release) no longer spawn * Logic tweaks for projectile Red Koins, Baraka's arena, Smoke missions and a few Red Koins * Added APWorld Manager update support
## Fixes * Seeds failing to generate with some option combinations * The client logging in when not at the main menu * PCSX2 losing connection or stalling while playing * DeathLink sending received deaths back out * The client spamming the server with EXP and goal updates * Filler EXP sometimes lost right before a loading screen * Some collected Red Koins respawning
## Note * 1.1.1 seeds won't work with 1.2.0, please regenerate * Sometimes you may have to try to press new game or load a save again if the client notifies you that your save does not belong to you even if it does.
# Docs * Updated the game guide with the new options, logic and client features https://github.com/orizach01/Archipelago-MKSM/blob/main/worlds/mksm/docs/en_Mortal%20Kombat%20Shaolin%20Monks.md
